Package aor.proj3t.daos

Class DAOFactory

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.daos.DAOFactory
@ApplicationScoped public class DAOFactory extends Object
Factory class to access all DAO implementations. This class provides a centralized access point for all the DAOs in the application. It follows the Factory design pattern to encapsulate the instantiation logic of DAOs and provides a clean, consistent API for accessing them.

Example usage: 

 User user = daoFactory.forUser().findById(userId).orElse(null);
 List trainings = daoFactory.forTraining().findAll();
